equipment.name: Clan Light Machine Gun Ammo - Full

fluff.overview: The Shoden Assault Vehicle emerged from Clan Nova Cat's effort to redefine its defensive posture following the Combine-Ghost Bear War of 3062 to 3063. Khan Santin West determined that the Nova Cats required a purpose-built combat vehicle capable of holding ground rather than seeking mobile engagements. Despite its classification as an assault vehicle, the Shoden was conceived as a defensive asset, intended to anchor lines and absorb enemy offensives. Produced at Barcella Beta on Irece, the design reflects Nova Cat adaptability and their growing accommodation of Draconis Combine sensibilities. The vehicle's name honors Shoden, the elephant god of wisdom from Japanese folklore, a deliberate cultural gesture acknowledging Nova Cat's partnership with the Combine. That naming choice proved apt: the Shoden brought hard-won tactical wisdom about combined-arms defense to every Provisional Galaxy that fielded it.
fluff.capabilities:
The Streak variant replaces two of the base design's ATM 9 launchers and the two front-mounted Light Machine Guns with four turret-mounted Streak SRM-6 launchers. The Streak guidance system guarantees a hit whenever a firing solution is achieved, eliminating the ammunition waste that affects standard SRM systems. Four tons of Streak SRM-6 ammunition supports sustained operations. The two remaining Series 2c Light Machine Guns, one per side, retain anti-infantry coverage for the flanks.

The trade-off is a reduction in maximum engagement range and the loss of the ATM system's munitions flexibility. The Streak variant cannot switch between extended-range and high-explosive loads. It commits fully to reliable close-to-medium-range performance. In formations with adequate long-range fire support from accompanying units, this is an acceptable compromise. In formations expected to engage across multiple range bands without support, the base design remains the preferred choice. Armor protection and mobility are unchanged from the base configuration.
fluff.deployment: The Streak variant was developed for units that prioritized ammunition efficiency over raw missile volume. Replacing two ATM 9 launchers and the front-mounted machine guns with four Streak SRM-6 launchers traded the ATM system's versatility for the guaranteed hit probability of Streak guidance. Field trials confirmed the variant suited formations that could not sustain the high ammunition throughput the base configuration demanded or that operated in environments where pinpoint accuracy outweighed flexible munitions selection.
fluff.history:
The catalyst for the Shoden's development was the Combine-Ghost Bear War of 3062 to 3063. That conflict exposed a critical gap in Nova Cat combat capabilities: the Clan's vehicle inventory consisted largely of designs suited to mobile warfare, not the defensive roles the Nova Cats increasingly played alongside Draconis Combine forces. Khan Santin West recognized that joint operations with Inner Sphere allies required a matching tactical vocabulary, including the kind of dug-in defensive firepower that BattleMech-centric Clan doctrine had never emphasized.

West authorized the retooling of a production line at Barcella Beta on Irece. Naming the vehicle Shoden honored the Japanese elephant god of wisdom and was a calculated gesture to the Combine hosts whose territory the Nova Cats now occupied. Nova Cat warriors expressed predictable skepticism, viewing combat vehicle production as a concession to Inner Sphere mediocrity. West acknowledged these concerns and pressed forward regardless, accepting that the Clan's long-term survival alongside the Combine depended on developing a more balanced combined-arms capability.

Production began in 3064 and the Shoden entered service across Nova Cat Provisional Galaxies, with all but Zeta eventually receiving the type. Tau Galaxy proved the most aggressive adopter, integrating the vehicle into its 100th Striker and 274th Battle Clusters as a core component of their defensive posture. Zeta Galaxy's resistance to vehicle deployment created a lasting cultural fault line with Tau Galaxy personnel. West addressed this friction by keeping the two galaxies' Shoden-equipped formations well separated rather than attempting to resolve the underlying ideological dispute.

The factory at Barcella Beta continued producing the Shoden through the Civil War period, but the Jihad severely disrupted Nova Cat industrial capacity on Irece. Word of Blake operations in 3072 targeted the planet's manufacturing infrastructure, and the Barcella Beta Shoden line was among the casualties. Production never resumed under Nova Cat management. After the Nova Cat Abjuration of the early Dark Age, Luthien Armor Works absorbed the Barcella Beta facility, redirecting it toward Draconis Combine production priorities.
